prompt: Implement the Bernstein-Vazirani circuit to recover a hidden 3-bit secret string s from the linear oracle f(x) = x0 XOR x2 (i.e. s = 101, bit 1 is unused) — the SAME target as the standard bv_4q task. Use qubits 0, 1, 2 as the input register and qubit 3 as the ancilla. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H directly — decompose it into this gate set.
